settings.label: What makes A-DIY different from traditional deck building?
settings.content: A-DIY is the first company in the world to offer professional, contractor-grade deck kits that anyone can assemble. Our patent-pending design eliminates cutting, measuring, and guesswork—everything fits together perfectly, just like Lego. The only tool you need is a hand drill, making it simple even if you’re not a handyman.

settings.label: Why should I choose A-DIY over hiring a contractor?
settings.content:
• Save thousands on labor costs.
  • No delays or hidden fees—know exactly what you’re paying for.
  • Install in under an hour, instead of waiting weeks for a contractor.
  • Enjoy a professional-grade deck with minimal effort.

settings.label: Do you build custom-sized decks?
settings.content: No, we offer pre-engineered deck kits in popular sizes to keep the process simple, affordable, and stress-free.

settings.label: I’m not sure what deck size I need. Can you help?
settings.content: Absolutely! You can send us pictures and measurements of your space, and we’ll connect you with a senior design consultant to recommend the best size for your needs.

settings.label: Can I attach multiple decks together?
settings.content: Yes! Our decks are modular, so you can combine multiple kits to create a larger or uniquely shaped deck.

settings.label: Can I trim or modify the deck?
settings.content: We do not recommend modifying our decks, as they are engineered to fit together perfectly. Any modifications may compromise the structure and void the warranty.

settings.label: What materials do you offer?
settings.content:
We offer two premium materials, all designed to last 20+ years:

  • Kiln Dried Pressure-Treated Lumber – Highly durable and cost-effective.
  • Composite – A modern, low-maintenance solution with a 25-year warranty.

settings.label: What is the subfloor made of?
settings.content: Our subfloors use kiln-dried pressure-treated lumber, with 6x6 beams and 2x8 joists for extra durability. The joists are spaced 14 inches apart, making the deck incredibly sturdy.

settings.label: How does the deck hold up in storms and strong winds?
settings.content: Our decks are sturdy and secure when properly installed. For areas with high winds, we recommend using cemented footings or sonotubes for added stability.

settings.label: Can I put a gazebo or hot tub on my deck?
settings.content:
• Gazebo: Yes! Just make sure it is securely fastened to the deck.
  • Hot Tub: If the deck is ground-level, yes! If elevated, check with a structural professional to ensure proper support.

settings.label: Is this deck strong enough for heavy furniture?
settings.content: Yes! Our decks are built to contractor-grade strength and can support typical outdoor furniture, grills, and lounge setups with ease.

settings.label: What comes with the deck kit?
settings.content: Every kit includes pre-cut, precision-engineered materials, screws, footings, and an easy-to-follow assembly guide. It arrives ready to assemble, so there’s no need for extra tools or multiple trips to the hardware store.

settings.label: How easy is it to assemble the deck?
settings.content: Our decks are designed to be assembled in under an hour using just a drill. No special tools, cutting, or measuring required—everything fits together seamlessly like Lego.

settings.label: Can I elevate the deck?
settings.content: Yes! Our decks are designed for ground-level installation, but you can elevate them using longer posts. We recommend keeping the height within 15 to 43 inches (3 to 4 steps) for best stability. If you want to go higher, consider cemented footings or sonotubes for additional support.

settings.label: Can I move or disassemble the deck?
settings.content: Yes! Our decks can be disassembled and moved if needed, making them perfect for temporary or semi-permanent installations.

settings.label: Do I need a permit to install this deck?
settings.content: Permit requirements vary by location. You should check with your local building authority. If needed, we can provide engineering diagrams to assist with your permit application.

settings.label: Do you offer financing?
settings.content:
Yes! We’ve partnered with Affirm to offer:

✔️ 0% interest for up to 24 months

✔️ $0 down payment options

settings.label: Do you have a physical store where I can see the decks in person?
settings.content: Currently, we do not have a physical store, but we are expanding our warehouses across the U.S. for faster shipping. You can check out customer reviews and photos on our website.

settings.label: How long does delivery take?
settings.content:
• Processing: Orders are prepared within 2–3 days.
  • Shipping: Delivery takes 7–14 days, depending on location.
  • Tracking: You’ll receive updates via email and text.

settings.label: What warranty do you offer?
settings.content:
• 5-year warranty on all deck parts.
  • 25-year warranty on composite decking.
